thread:
Acme Dev: Hey, hitting a 415 when trying to stream rerank results. Our client tried to open an SSE connection to /v1/rerank and then retried a bunch of times — now our billing is way up. Anyone seen this?
Priya (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request you sent (headers + body)? 415 usually content-type related. Also roughly how many retries/calls did your client make?
Acme Dev: Here's the curl we used: ```
curl -i -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \ 
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
  -d '{"query":"best laptops","documents":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```
We saw an immediate 415 body: "Unsupported Media Type" and our client lib retried with exponential backoff but no jitter, ended up doing ~9 attempts over 3 minutes. Billing shows token charges for each attempt.
Priya (Support): OK thanks. Quick repro note: the rerank endpoint does NOT support streaming/SSE. Accept: text/event-stream triggers a 415 from the runtime because it expects a synchronous JSON response. Can you confirm your client added automatic retries on ANY 4xx/5xx? If so we should prevent retry on 4xx.
Acme Dev: Yeah our SDK was set to retry 5xx only but due to a bug it retried on all non-2xx. Fixing that now. But can we get a billing adjustment for the extra token charges?
Ethan (SRE): I just repro'd with the exact curl. Response headers: ```
HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8
date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 14:05:40 GMT
content-length: 72
```
Body: ```
{"error":"Unsupported Media Type: rerank endpoint does not support streaming (Accept: text/event-stream)"}
```
Ethan (SRE): Server is deliberately rejecting streaming on rerank; we return 415. The error text in prod currently is generic so I pasted the body I saw — looks like prod already returns that message but older runtimes may return a shorter message.
Marisol (ML Eng): For context: rerank performs synchronous scoring over the provided documents and returns a ranked array; there's no streaming semantics to emit partial scores. If teams want streaming semantics they should use the generate/chat endpoints with a re-ranking step client-side or call rerank in a batched async job.
Priya (Support): Next steps for us: (1) Confirm refund eligibility, (2) recommend client fixes (do not set Accept: text/event-stream for rerank; use Content-Type: application/json and single POST), (3) update docs + SDK examples to call out that rerank is non-streaming and to not retry 4xx.
billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-4821 for invoice review and potential credit. Assigned to billing-team.
Priya (Support): Quick repro steps for internal triage: 
1) Run the curl above (with Accept: text/event-stream) against /v1/rerank -> observe 415.
2) Change Accept to \"application/json\" and POST -> expect 200 with JSON payload: `\{"scores\": [...], \"ranking\": [...]}`.
3) Simulate client retries by sending repeated requests -> confirm token charges per request.
4) Check logs via request-id X-Req-Id header if customer supplies it; otherwise search by src-ip and time window.
Ethan (SRE): Logs I saw (sanitized): `src_ip=54.33.12.11 path=/v1/rerank method=POST accept=text/event-stream status=415 latency_ms=12`
Marisol (ML Eng): Suggestion: we should make the error message even more actionable: e.g., `Unsupported Media Type: rerank does not support streaming (remove Accept: text/event-stream or use /v1/chat for streaming)`. I'll open a PR to update the runtime error strings and add a doc blurb.
Priya (Support): I'll ask billing for a provisional credit while they fix their SDK. Acme Dev — once you post the SDK version and the request-ids I'll push for an immediate adjustment. Can you also share the number of failed attempts from your client and any request-ids?
Acme Dev: Thanks — we found 9 failed attempts. We have one request-id in logs: req_7a9b2c. Sending it now. Also we'll release a patched SDK with retry rule fix. Sorry for the mess. :grimacing:
Priya (Support): No worries. We'll escalate billing with req_7a9b2c and the timestamps. Marisol — assign me a docs PR link once ready and Ethan, if you can add a test to ensure 415 is returned for Accept: text/event-stream for rerank, that's helpful.
Ethan (SRE): Will do. I'll add a small integration test to the runtime test-suite.
Marisol (ML Eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/p/rerank-docs/patch-415 — adds a short note under rerank limitations and example curl showing correct headers.
Priya (Support): Closing loop: billing submitted BILL-4821 and gave customer provisional credit while we investigate. Marking this thread as resolved for now, will re-open if refund denied. :thumbsup:
Acme Dev: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help.
